contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md present. Follow patterns already in the codebase. All UI text must be in Bangla (Unicode). No English labels in UI. Prayer times must use 12-hour Bangla AM/PM (সকাল/দুপুর/বিকাল/রাত) format converted from HH:MM API response via Dart intl.
key_patterns: 1. Screens are ConsumerWidgets using Riverpod StreamProvider/FutureProvider. Providers are file-level (not inside classes). 2. Firestore streams: `FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection(colName).snapshots().map(...)` pattern. 3. Upazila filter chips are always a horizontal SizedBox(height:44) ListView. 4. Cards: white Container with borderRadius:12, boxShadow opacity 0.06, padding:14. 5. AppTheme static colors used everywhere — never hardcode colors outside AppTheme. 6. CallButton widget handles direct phone calls. 7. VerifiedBadge widget for verified items. 8. SectionHeader widget for titled sections with optional 'see all' action. 9. go_router: `context.go()` for shell tabs, `context.push()` for detail screens. 10. All new Firestore collections use constants from AppConstants. 11. GenericServiceModel covers pharmacies/education/transport/finance/businesses/govt_services/police_stations/electricity_offices/islamic/professionals/organizations/jobs — all share the same model/service.
directory_structure: mobile/ — Flutter project root. lib/config/ — AppTheme, AppConstants, router. lib/models/ — one file per Firestore collection model. lib/services/ — one file per service (Firestore or HTTP). lib/screens/ — one subfolder per feature screen. lib/widgets/ — reusable shared widgets. lib/utils/ — currently empty. assets/images/ and assets/fonts/ — static assets.
